formula_interpretation: Outside-any is an OR over24 marginal min/max violations; per-feature counts overlap and must not be added as independent row counts.
Envelope bounds use E0 all physical classes or E0 physical-negative rows exactly as separately named; they are not confidence limits or guarantees of joint distribution support.
The score statistics use only existing sealed scores; no model outputs were recalculated.
The coefficient signs describe conditional change of the fitted linear logit per standardized feature unit with other feature coordinates fixed, not marginal importance or physical causality.

conclusions.observed: E1 negative-action rows have saved scores much lower than E0 negatives, with substantial marginal feature-range differences from the original E0 training population.
conclusions.limits: This is evidence of training-support/distribution mismatch for this fixed learner, not proof of the complete or unique failure cause, all-feature nonidentifiability, a nonlinear-model cure, or the impossibility of all learned admission methods.
conclusions.inside_box: Rows inside every marginal E0 range may still have unrepresented joint combinations or class-conditional relationships; box membership does not establish training support or explain successful/failing predictions.
conclusions.population: Rows are correlated current cell-exposure instances, not distinct independent cells/scenes or new navigation outcomes.
conclusions.candidate_status: The original fixed learner and physical reservation remain closed. No threshold/normalization/feature change, additional acquisition/refit or model selection is admitted by this diagnosis.
conclusions.next_scope: Any further work can first specify a separate training-support contract on already-seen scenes; it cannot reinterpret those scenes as fresh validation or retroactively reopen the rejected fit.
